proposals.title: Mortgage commitments: separate notional, fair value and earnings
proposals.plan: Original multi-cohort commitment register with signed fair-value changes, separate asset/liability totals, exclusion routing and closing-rate sensitivity; values stipulated, not a valuation recipe.

proposals.title: Servicing assets: keep the measurement election separate from cash collected
proposals.plan: Original two-class closing register with separately stipulated elections, supplied amortization and impairment, fair-value changes, servicing cash and alternative-value sensitivity.

proposals.title: Capital impairment and insurance: separate the asset loss from the recovery timeline
proposals.plan: Original multi-period government-wide asset and recovery bridge with independently measured impairment, received versus unsupported claims, separate restoration work and no automatic reversal.

proposals.title: Nontrust OPEB: reconcile the liability, deferred resources and benefit payments
proposals.plan: Original supplied-actuarial-output ledger bridge for a no-trust plan with coincident measurement/reporting dates; separate liability movement, expense, benefit cash and remaining deferred amounts.
